column_description: Unique identifier for each flight log.
Reference to the drone that the flight log belongs to. may be NULL.
Start time of the drone flight. may be NULL.
End time of the drone flight. may be NULL.
Status of the flight (e.g., completed, aborted). always exactly one of 'completed', 'aborted'. may be NULL.
Starting point of the flight. may be NULL.
Ending point of the flight. may be NULL.
ID of the planned route. may be NULL.
Total distance covered in the flight. may be NULL.
Average speed of the flight. may be NULL.
Battery used during the flight. may be NULL.
